Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for making time. Aegis is starting an interactive SOC 2 review next week and Harbor will need short-term access to your trust portal to pull the Type II artifacts and also to review a CAIQ / SIG mapping we requested. Can you do the following before the audit kickoff on Mon 26 Feb?

- Provision two temporary reviewer accounts (view-only) for Harbor auditors: Emma Chen (emma.chen@harbor-audit.com) and Luis Ortega (luis.ortega@harbor-audit.com)
- Provide a one-time SSO link (or ephemeral SSO) that expires after 72 hours
- Share a redacted copy of the Type II report and the CAIQ spreadsheet in the portal (redaction guidance attached)
- Confirm audit period: we expect to cover 2023-07-01 through 2024-06-30; let us know if that matches your reporting window

Also can you provide a short bridge letter that confirms there were no control changes material to the report window? We can get that signed via DocuSign if you can upload a draft.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any IP allowlist details if needed.

Best,
Maria
Head of Vendor Risk — Aegis Financial

Hi Maria — thanks for the detail. We can support the scope and timeline. Plan below (TL;DR: ephemeral SSO + proxy accounts, redacted Type II, CAIQ mapping):

1) Access: we will create two ephemeral reviewer accounts and a one-time SSO link that expires 72 hours after first use. We will also provide a timebox for activity (Mon 26 09:00 PST — Thu 29 18:00 PST).

2) Audit period: your suggested window 2023-07-01 -> 2024-06-30 matches our SOC 2 scope. We'll include that in the bridge letter draft.

3) Evidence: we will stage a redacted Type II PDF and the CAIQ spreadsheet in a secure folder in the trust portal. Link will be restricted to the two accounts + IP allowlist if you provide one.

4) Bridge letter: attached is a draft (bridge_letter_draft.docx). If that looks correct we can route via DocuSign and add the signed copy to the portal.

Action items for Aegis: please confirm the auditor emails (we have Emma and Luis from the CC; confirm names), and provide any IP addresses to allow.

Notes for our team: Kimberly — can you please remove billing tables and PII from the Type II before upload (redaction guidance attached by Aegis)? Priyom — please prepare the ephemeral SSO flow and set the 72-hour expiration and activity logging.

I will upload the redacted artifacts to the portal once we have confirmation.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
